scripts.restart: bun run stop; sleep 1; bun run start:bg
scripts.start:bg: mkdir -p .run && CMUX_REMOTE_TLS=1 nohup bun src/index.ts >> .run/server.log 2>&1 & echo "server up on :${PORT:-48701} (TLS) — logs: apps/server/.run/server.log"
scripts.status: lsof -ti tcp:${PORT:-48701} -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "running on :${PORT:-48701}" || echo stopped
scripts.stop: PIDS=$(lsof -ti tcp:${PORT:-48701} -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then kill $PIDS && echo 'server down'; else echo 'not running'; fi
